title: Study of GX-471 in Breast cancer — Phase Ii Clinical Trial (2020)
text:
Dr. Priya Krishnan and colleagues at CMC Vellore investigated the efficacy of GX-471 against Breast cancer. 
Using a phase II clinical trial, the team demonstrated 61% inhibition at a minimum inhibitory concentration of 21.8 μg/mL. 
The compound showed a favorable safety profile in preliminary toxicity assays. 
This work was conducted in collaboration with IIT Bombay and partially funded by the European Research Council. 
Results suggest GX-471 may represent a novel therapeutic candidate warranting phase 1 clinical evaluation.

title: Study of GX-471 in Alzheimer's disease — Retrospective Cohort Study (2020)
text:
A retrospective cohort study conducted at USP São Paulo examined the molecular mechanisms by which GX-471 exerts 
activity against Alzheimer's disease. Dr. Maria Santos reported that the compound disrupts VEGFR2 signaling, 
leading to cell cycle arrest in treated samples. The IC50 was measured at 176.7 nM. 
Co-authors from Karolinska Institute contributed proteomic analysis. 
The study was published in Journal of Medicinal Chemistry and received 221 citations within the first year.

title: Study of GSK-441 in Tuberculosis — Mouse Xenograft Model (2020)
text:
This paper from CMC Vellore presents a mouse xenograft model evaluating GSK-441 as a treatment for Tuberculosis. 
Lead author Dr. Priya Krishnan demonstrated 65% response rate in the treatment arm compared to 17% in controls. 
Adverse events were mild to moderate. Biomarker analysis revealed that patients with elevated IL-6 levels 
responded significantly better. A larger multi-center trial is currently recruiting across 
CMC Vellore, IIT Bombay, and two additional sites.
